name: 500Conference by 500apps
description_en:
The 500Conference domain currently redirects to an official 500apps/500agents transition notice. The notice says the 500apps suite is winding down over ninety days, with services closing at the end of that process and customer exports available through support. It does not provide a calendar start date in the read text.

The former video-conferencing candidate must not be presented as an indefinitely available service. The new 500agents platform is a separate direction, not a verified equivalent meeting product. Current 500Conference account availability, final closure date and migration terms remain unverified.
description_zh:
500Conference 域名当前跳转到 500apps/500agents 官方过渡公告。公告表示 500apps 套件将在九十天内退场，过程结束后关闭服务，客户可通过支持团队导出数据；读取文本未给出明确起始日期。

原视频会议候选不能继续描述为长期可用服务。新的 500agents 是另一产品方向，未证明是等价会议产品。当前 500Conference 账户可用性、最终关闭日期及迁移条款仍未核实。
